name: Donchian four-week rule
author: Richard Donchian (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Buy when price exceeds the highest high of the previous four full weeks (20 trading days).
entry_short: Price falls below the lowest low of the previous four full weeks.
exit: Stop-and-reverse: sell/go short when price falls below the lowest low of the previous four weeks.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Described as the best popular system rated by Dunn and Hargitt in 1970; no performance numbers captured here. Similar to existing Donchian items but with the specific 4-week definition.
